page.title: AI Settings
page.description: Configure AI assistants, agents, tools, and observability.

copilotAdminLinks.title: Engenty
copilotAdminLinks.description: Manage Copilot, agents, skills, and tools in the Engenty admin workspace.

rows.actions: Actions agents can run in this workspace

docConverter.providerHelp: If the preferred backend is unavailable for a file type or not configured, conversion falls back to the local extractor.
docConverter.geminiModelHelp: AI Gateway model id (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash). Leave empty to use the default.
docConverter.mistralModelHelp: Mistral OCR model id (e.g. mistral-ocr-latest). Leave empty to use the default.

matrix.title: Model matrix
matrix.description: One model per purpose. A blank pick inherits the platform default; the badge shows where the effective value comes from.
matrix.allowlistNote: Your plan limits which models are available. The picker shows only the models included in your plan.

chat.label: Chat
chat.desc: User-facing replies — copilot and specialist agents.

routing.label: Fast (routing)
routing.desc: Supervisor delegation, thread titles, tool search — frequent and cheap.

research.label: Research
research.desc: Search & retrieval agents, workspace search, deep-research fan-outs — long context.

planning_coding.label: Planning & coding
planning_coding.desc: Most-capable tier: plans, task decomposition, coordinator proposals, sandboxed code.

auto.label: Auto
auto.desc: Let Engenty size the work for each request.

high.label: High
high.desc: Hard problems worth the extra thinking.

tiers.title: Effort tiers
tiers.description: How much thinking your workspace may buy. People pick a tier, never a model id; the platform binds each tier to a model.
tiers.managedNote: Your plan decides which effort tiers this workspace can use.
tiers.keepOne: At least one tier has to stay available.

expert.hint: Self-hosted and expert installs can still pin a model per purpose. A pinned model wins over the effort tier.

picker.title: Choose a model for {{purpose}}
picker.description: Pick a model or inherit the platform default. Pricing is per million tokens (input / output).

limits.loadError: Couldn't load the usage policy. Ensure apps/ai is running and reachable.
limits.enforcementDesc: Cap AI spend per period. Observe warns; enforce blocks calls once the hard limit is reached.

mode.observeHint: Over-limit calls still run; you get banners and headers.
mode.enforceHint: Over-limit calls are rejected with a structured 429.

limits.softLimitHint: Admin warning banner; calls keep running.
limits.hardLimitHint: When enforcing, calls are blocked past this.
limits.iterationCapDesc: Tenant default for how many steps an agent run may take (platform max 60). Saved with the model settings via the top bar.
limits.iterationCapHint: Leave blank to inherit the platform default. Agents can be capped lower individually.
limits.allowlistDesc: When set, only these models may be called. Empty means all Gateway models are allowed.
limits.managedDesc: Your AI budgets and model access are set by your plan. These values are shown for transparency and are read-only here — contact your platform administrator to change them.

agentsTab.title: Per-agent overrides
agentsTab.description: Pin a model, tier, iteration cap, or spend cap for individual agents. Blank inherits the tenant default. Code-managed agents are set in code.
agentsTab.loadError: Couldn't load agents. Ensure apps/ai is running and reachable.

voice.title: Realtime voice
voice.description: Voice and models for the realtime voice agent (OpenAI Realtime). Blank inherits the platform default.
voice.help: The OpenAI API key is set via environment variables, not stored here.

sections.copilotDesc: Chat model defaults for this tenant.
sections.classifierDesc: Fast, single-call models for inbox attachment scanning and routing (no extended reasoning).
sections.classifierHint: Prefer a small model such as gpt-5-nano or gpt-5-mini for lower latency and cost.
sections.routingModelHint: Used for the copilot supervisor and lightweight decisions (thread titles, tool discovery). Prefer a faster, cheaper model than chat.
sections.modelCatalogEmpty: No Gateway models in the catalog yet. Restart apps/ai after migrate, or ask a superadmin to POST /ai/v1/gateway/models/sync. The catalog auto-syncs on startup when empty.
sections.modelCatalogLoadError: Could not load the Gateway model catalog. Ensure apps/ai is running (pnpm dev:ai) and reachable from the UI — same-origin via the dev proxy or set VITE_ENGENTY_AI_BASE_URL.
sections.docConverterDesc: Choose how uploaded office files and PDFs are turned into Markdown (e.g. knowledge-base uploads). API keys are set via environment variables, not stored here.

agents.runActionDescription: Execute this registered action now with optional raw JSON input and context.

settingsOverview.triggersDescription: Entry points that can start this agent (UI routes).
settingsOverview.triggersLimitedNote: Editing, adding, or disabling triggers from this screen is not available yet — this is a read-only overview.
settingsOverview.instructionsDescription: Preview of what this agent uses on each run. Hover a block and use the edit control to open the Instructions tab.
settingsOverview.instructionsPreviewEmpty: No content yet — add text in the Instructions tab.
settingsOverview.actionsDescription: Runnable tasks linked to this agent. Use Run action to test or invoke one; input is optional when the action defines a schema.
settingsOverview.skillsDescription: Capabilities (skills) this agent may use — assigned on the agent or brought in through actions. View or change them in the Skills catalog.
settingsOverview.toolsDescription: Tools available to this agent through its skills (capabilities). Each entry is a function the model can use during a run.

artifactsCatalog.title: Artifacts
artifactsCatalog.lede: Documents created by agents and users — grouped by their scope (chat, task, project, goal), which decides who can see them.
artifactsCatalog.emptyDescription: Artifacts appear when an agent produces a document, table, or HTML.

toolsCatalog.description: Module, MCP, and custom tools available in the registry.

realtimeVoice.title: Realtime voice
realtimeVoice.description: Provider and voice for realtime voice conversations in the copilot and chatbot.
realtimeVoice.openAiHelp: Direct speech-to-speech via OpenAI Realtime over WebRTC. Lowest latency; voice and accent are fixed by OpenAI.
realtimeVoice.cascadePipelineHelp: Voxtral transcription → your copilot agent → ElevenLabs voice, brokered by the server. Enables Austrian/Bavarian dialect voices; requires MISTRAL_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on the server.
realtimeVoice.elevenLabsVoiceIdPlaceholder: Voice id (e.g. an Austrian dialect voice)
realtimeVoice.cascadeKeysMissing: Cascade needs MISTRAL_API_KEY and ELEVENLABS_API_KEY on the server (Setup → Platform). Restart apps/ai after changing keys.

errors.elevenLabsApiKeyMissing: ElevenLabs API key is not configured on the server.
errors.elevenLabsApiKeyMissingPermissions: ElevenLabs API key is missing permissions (needs at least voices_read + text_to_speech). Create a new key in the ElevenLabs console with those scopes, update .env.local / Setup → Platform, and restart apps/ai.
errors.elevenLabsApiKeyInvalid: ElevenLabs API key was rejected (401/403). Update it in Setup → Platform and restart apps/ai.
errors.elevenLabsVoicesUnavailable: Could not load ElevenLabs voices. Check the server key and network, then retry.

realtimeVoice.voiceRegisterHelp: Steers the assistant's word choice (Jänner, Sackerl, Grüß Gott) on every provider. The spoken accent comes from the selected voice.
